description.en:
The year is 2041. It has been several years since the development of Artificial Body technology, commonly known as "Mimic." Captain Chris Armstrong, after suffering a serious injury from an unexpected incident during a military operation, undergoes mimic surgery and returns to the frontlines... or at least, that was the plan. After the surgery, there was something strange about his body. His reflection that he saw in the mirror had soft white skin, complimented by silky hair——it was a beautiful girl!?!!?

Amidst the flames of war writhing with conspiracy and resentment, a makeshift team of four girl-type mimics was formed. Their name: Mimicry Girls.

Shooting, CQC, infiltration. A mission was given to these girls that were specialists in all fields. That is, to escort the president's daughter from the international criminal organization "Val Verde" that is out for her life. After a cool tea party is the start of a cute operation! Taking on the form of girls, they face off against the world's greatest evils!
description.ja:
第28回電撃小説大賞《銀賞》受賞作をキャラクターデザインも手掛けるあさなや先生が衝撃のコミカライズ!! 2041年。人工素体技術――通称《ミミック》が開発された世界。作戦中、重傷を負ってしまったクリス・アームストロング大尉は素体化手術を受け、なんと美少女の姿に!?

謀略と怨嗟が蠢く戦火の陰で突如結成された、4体の少女型素体からなる即席部隊。その名は――『ミミクリー・ガールズ』。射撃、格闘、潜入。あらゆる分野のスペシャリストである彼女たちに与えられたミッション。それは謎の国際犯罪組織"バル・ベルデ"に狙われた大統領の娘の護衛だった。クールなティータイムの後は、キュートに作戦開始!少女に擬態し、世界の巨悪に立ち向かえ――!

Shizuru was exhausted and felt cornered at his exploitative company.
One day he inherited a farm in another world from his beloved grandpa!
On top of that, when he travels to the other world, he somehow turns into a girl-!?
The start of a genderswapped transfer to another world , a fluffy slow life with cute animals!!
description.ja:
ブラック企業勤めで疲弊し、追い込まれていた静流。
ある日、大好きな祖父から譲り受けたのは、異世界の牧場だった!?　
その上、異世界に行くと、なぜか少女の姿になっており――!?
可愛い動物たちとモフモフスローライフをおくるTS異世界転移開幕!!

description.en:
The heroine Hitsuji is nicknamed "Kigurumi-chan" by her surroundings. While she is friendly with everyone thanks to her easygoing personality, she is distressed about not being treated as a girl. She's always had an unrequited love for her classmate Touya, who always quarrels with her.   
  
One day, the number one popular boy in the school and the student council president Fujiwara-kun suddenly gives her the new nickname "Mojako"…
description.pt-br: A protagonista Hitsuji, tem o apelido de "Kigurumi-chan" pelas pessoas á sua volta. Por ser amiga de todo mundo graças a sua personalidade fácil e simpática, ela se preocupa com o fato de não ser tratada como uma garota (e Hitsuji tem uma quedinha por Toyua, o garoto que sempre briga com ela). Um dia o garoto mais popular da escola e o presidente do conselho estudantil Fujiwara-kun, de repente lhe dá o apelido de "Mojako".

altTitles.ja-ro: Joou Ophiria yo, Onore no Shi no Nazo wo Toke

description.en:
On the verge of death, Queen Ophelia wished—

"I want to know who killed me."

Then, in accordance with an "ancient promise" given only to the owner of the crown, the Fairy King Leah brought her back to life for just ten days!

“I died once, so this time I will do whatever I want.”

Ophelia's husband, who tried to use her to seize power... her brother, who is unreliable and tends to be swayed by those around him... a knight of the Royal Guard who has fallen in love with her... the list of possible culprits is endless. Who killed the queen?!

A royal mystery begins in the palace with a strong slap that will clear the Queen's name before her death!

(Source: ComicWalker)
description.ja:
「私は、私を殺した犯人を知りたい」
死の間際、薄れゆく意識の中で女王オフィーリアはそう願う。
すると、王冠の持ち主にだけ与えられる“古の約束”により、妖精王リアは十日間だけオフィーリアを生き返らせてくれた。
「一度は死んだ身よ。ならば今度こそやりたいことを全てやってやるわ」
オフィーリアを使って権力を握ろうとした夫、
周囲に流されがちで頼りない弟、
恋心を寄せてくる近衛騎士……
数え上げればキリがない犯人候補たち。
女王を殺したのは誰なのか!?
生前の雪辱を晴らす強烈な平手打ちが炸裂する王宮ミステリー開幕!!

description.en:
Miyazen Sakura and Matsubayashi Shouta are two classmates that are polar opposites: Miyazen, the high-class pretty girl, and Matsubayashi, the scary-looking delinquent guy. Oblivious to each other's feelings, they actually want to get to know each other but can’t seem to communicate properly! [Kodansha]
  
---

description.tl: Si Souta Matsubayashi ay tinitingnan ng kanyang mga kaklase bilang isang delikwenteng siga, samantalang si Sakura Miyazen ay itinuturing na isang magandang prinsesa. Sa kanilang panlabas na anyo, tila wala silang pagkakapareho. Gayunpaman, nang magsimula ang pasukan na magkasama sa iisang klase ang dalawang magkasalungat, parehong nais nilang mapalapit sa isa’t isa, ngunit nahihirapan sila dahil sa kaba kapag sinusubukan nilang magsimula ng pag-uusap.

Trying to find out who he likes, she sets up a group dating between her friends and the guys of this circle in a Maid Cafe. What she doesn't know is that certain big chested maid is about to enter the game!

Чтобы узнать кто ему нравится и есть ли у неё шанс, она организует в кафе групповое свидание между своими подругами и друзьями Рито. Но она ещё не знает, что в игру вступит горничная.

description.en:
Gotou Kensuke (a.k.a. Dr. Koto), a brilliant surgeon who had been working at a famous university hospital in Tokyo, took responsibility for a medical error and came to the remote island of Koshiki, which had been without a doctor for three months. The clinic there lacked medical facilities and was unable to provide full-scale treatment or surgery, and could only send patients to a hospital on the mainland, a six-hour boat ride away. Then a village boy came down with acute appendicitis!
Will Koto continue to transport them to the mainland? Or...

---
  
- Won the Shogakukan Manga Award for general manga in 2004.
- Published in Indonesian as *Dr. Koto* by Elex Media Komputindo (2010).
description.id: Pulau Koshiki, pulau terisolasi oleh laut yang jauh dari mana pun. Namun saat seorang dokter bedah jenius mendarat di pulau yang tak punya fasilitas memadai ini, sebuah kisah drama penuh keajaiban pun dimulai! Operasi aneurisma, pneumothorax, sampai persalinan? Kensuke Goto, pria ini seolah memiliki kemampuan yang hebat untuk menyembuhkan penyakit seberat apa pun. Kisah dokter di pulau terpencil yang mengharukan yang mempertanyakan makna hidup sesungguhnya.
description.vi: Bác sĩ từ bệnh viện đại học Tokyo đến Koshiki, một hòn đảo nhỏ ngoài khơi xa. Người dân ở đây không được quan tâm đến y tế nhiều, và ngay cả chính họ cũng không chú trọng điều đó. Nếu có người đổ ca bệnh nặng, họ phải di chuyển đến đất liền nơi có bệnh viện trung ương để tiến hành chữa trị. Hãy cùng theo dõi hành trình của vị bác sĩ này, kỹ năng, các tình huống và cách mà anh ấy xử trí!!

description.en: Rikuo Nura is descended from Nurarihyon, Grand Master of the spirit world, but appears to be just a normal kid. He usually just wants to live peacefully as a human, but when his friends and allies are in trouble, his spirit blood boils, and he transforms into Nurarihyon to wipe out evil! A new concept story combining spirits and chivalry! A piquant, gallant ghost action story!
description.ru: Монстры живут среди нас! Не верите? Спросите у Рикуо, для него это более чем реально. Ведь его дом битком набит монстрами всех видов и размеров, а всё потому, что дедушка у Рикуо — сам Нурарихён, предводитель всех монстров. Вот только Рикуо — монстр лишь на четверть и хоть и является наследником столь значительного титула, отказывается заниматься типичной для монстров деятельностью, то есть пугать людей, а иногда и перекусывать ими… Нет, он ходит в школу, самоотверженно помогает людям, иногда даже слишком, но стоит пробить полночи, и кровь нелюдей даёт о себе знать. Ведь ночью пробуждается он, Нурарихён Третий — будущий повелитель всей нечисти, уже вселяющий страх в сердца людей и ведущий за собой орды монстров.

description.en:
A positive isekai life woven by a cheat-level magical seamstress and her spider partner!

After dying of illness, a young girl named Lily is blessed by a goddess and reincarnated in another world. With a healthy body and the ability of "Magic Sewing," the hopeful Lily encounters a giant magic spider. She tames it and names it "Tarato." That magic spider turned out to be a rare monster that produces valuable threads!? While enjoying her new life, Lily's clothing made with her "Magic Sewing" ability and the rare threads gradually become the talk of the town—!? As she gently polishes her sewing and weaving skills, she works hard every day with the goal of opening her own shop!
description.ja:
チートな魔法裁縫士と蜘蛛な相棒が紡ぐ、ポジティブ異世界ライフ！

病死したため女神の祝福を受け異世界に転生した少女・リリィ。健康な身体と『魔法裁縫』の能力を授かって、希望に満ち溢れるリリィが出会ったのはおおきな魔蜘蛛。テイムをして“タラト”と名付けたその魔蜘蛛は希少な糸を生むレアモンスターだった!? 新しい人生を謳歌するリリィですが、『魔法裁縫』の能力×希少な糸でつくった服飾品が次第に話題になって——！？裁縫＆紡績スキルをゆるゆる磨きつつ、自分のお店を開くため今日も頑張ります！

altTitles.ja: ゴールデンタイム

description.en: Tada Banri, a newly admitted student at a private law school in Tokyo, found himself completely lost after the opening ceremony, trying to find his way to the freshman orientation. At that moment, he ran into another lost freshman from the same school, Yanagisawa Mitsuo, and they hit it off at once. Somehow arriving at their intended goal just on time, there appeared in front of the two a beautiful girl holding a bouquet of roses. The girl then whacked Mitsuo across the face with the bouquet and handed the flowers over to him. “Freshman, congratulations”, was all she said, and then she left. The stylish, well dressed, perfect woman that had swung at Mitsuo was his childhood friend, Kaga Kouko. As children they had promised to marry each other one day, fulfilling their dreams. In order to escape from her, Mitsuo had gone out secretly and taken the examination for this well known private college, but now she showed up in the freshman orientation hall. She too had taken the law school entrance examination, catching up with him there.

description.en: Wakaba (20) is a college debutante who yearns for youth. When she goes out on Halloween dressed in her school uniform, she ends up going on a date with a high school boy named Tachibana! But in fact, this boy is also a college student whose friend left him out of the date... In order to make Wakaba's dream come true, she is asked to continue going out with him on his Seifuku dates!
description.ja:
青春に憧れる、大学デビュー女子のわかば。20歳のハロウィンに制服コスで街へ出てみたら、なりゆきで高校生・郁斗とデートすることに！

「もし私も高校生だったらこのまま付き合う未来とかもあったのかな」

今日限りのデートだと名残惜しくなっていたけれど、「とある事情」で一緒に青春をやり直すことになり…？憧れシチュにふたりで挑戦！ニセモノ高校生の制服リトライラブ！
description.pt-br:
Wakaba é uma universitária caloura que anseia pela juventude. Quando ela sai no Halloween vestida com seu uniforme escolar, ela acaba indo a um encontro com um garoto do ensino médio chamado Tachibana! Mas, na verdade, esse garoto também é um universitário cujos amigos o deixaram de fora do encontro... Para realizar o sonho de Wakaba, ele pede que ela continue saindo com ele em seus encontros de uniforme escolar. 

Uma história sobre duas pessoas que querem reviver sua juventude perdida.

He reunites with his childhood friend, Kanna, but she has become a genius entrepreneur, earning several hundred million yen a year while still a high school student! Furthermore, his class also includes the next ace of Japan's track and field world and a nationally famous actress, and he learns that he is, in fact, at a prestigious high school where geniuses gather. For some reason, these high-spec girls start showing up at Jinpei's house...?!
description.ja: 担任からの勧めで上京し、高校に入学した五木陣平(いつきじんぺい)。彼は幼馴染の環奈と再会するが、彼女は女子高生にして年商数億を稼ぐ天才経営者になっていた!さらにクラスには、日本陸上界の次期エースや国民的女優までいて、実はここが天才が集まる名門高校だったことを知る。そんなハイスペックな女子たちが、なぜか陣平の家に押しかけてきて……！？

なんか小さくてかわいいやつ＝通称「ちいかわ」たちが繰り広げる、楽しくて、切なくて、ちょっとハードな日々の物語。

description.en:
In a world teeming with wizards who slay humans in their unrelenting pursuit of blood, two unique paths converge.

Howcuttle, a wizard who only has a mouth, perpetually gnawing at the edges of hunger, meets Beni, a girl of untainted innocence and devoid of anything but her name. Together, they embark on an aimless journey, their footsteps tracing the veins of a world replete with torment and tender compassion in equal measure.

The prodigiously talented illustrator, Shida, welcomes you to this Neo-Isekai Dark Fantasy world!!!

The only things that are still awake in this world are sheep, me, and her. It's a decadent romance created by a genius!  
  
One day humanity fell asleep and the only ones still awake are me and my cheeky junior Sawada who transformed into a witch. 
Our romantic comedy is about to awake in this deteriorating world where everything’s asleep!

description.en:
Noein is the son of a nobleman's father and his mistress. 
Despised by his family and servants, Noein grew up to be a twisted character, and after a 15 years of house arrest, he was evicted from the mansion. 
Instead of severing ties with his family, Noein was given an territory on the kingdom's frontier and the title of lord. 
But the frontier is nothing but a vast expanse of untamed forest.

Determined to develop the frontier and become the happiest lord of all, Noein sets out to cultivate the land. With the golem manipulation magic he mastered while under house arrest and the advanced knowledge he acquired from books, he plows the wasteland and begins farming. 
The first two stages of the project go smoothly, but the most important thing is that there are no residents in the territory.
description.es: Noein, nacido de un padre de la nobleza y su amante, se vio obligado a vivir bajo arresto domiciliario desde una edad muy temprana y fue despreciado por quienes le rodeaban. En lugar de romper sus lazos familiares, le fue otorgado un enclave en la frontera del reino y un título de señor feudal. Pero, lo único que encuentra allí es una vasta extensión de bosque inexplorado. ¡Como venganza contra su padre, Noein jura "ser más feliz que nadie con el pueblo" y se lanza a explorar la frontera para lograr su objetivo...!

description.en:
Fushimi Inari has a hopeless crush on her classmate Tanbabashi. One day, while trying to interact with him, she accidentally humiliates him in front of the whole class. He refuses to accept her apologies, and, to make matters worse, she discovers that he probably has a crush on their incredibly cute classmate Sumizome.  
  
She has all these things in mind when she is summoned by Uka-no-Mitama-no-kami, a pale fox goddess. In return for rescuing a little fox-spirit creature before school that day, the goddess offers to grant a single wish of Inari's. Without thinking, she blurts out that she wants to be Sumizome. As one might expect, this wish does not go nearly as well as Inari had hoped, and the kindly goddess breaks a goddess-rule to give Inari the ability to change herself back. Now, Inari can change her own shape at will, and using her new skill is very tempting as she keeps trying to win Tanbabashi's heart. But if Inari flaunts her ability, both she and the goddess might end up in trouble with Amaterasu!

description.en:
Description via YuriNavi:  
  
"Nomura Nao and Kyougoku Hina" is the story about two high school girls, Nomura Nao and Kyougoku Hina, who sit in the same class. Nao has always had trouble with Hina, who seems to always be in a bad mood. But one day after school, she runs into Hina who is taking care of her younger siblings. Nao dislikes her own family, but seeing Hina as a caring older sister, Nao's opinion of Hina changes drastically. As Nao spends time with the Kyougokus, she starts to learn what family is really about.  
  
The author and artist is Chariot-san (@imgayhowbouthat), who writes creative yuri manga. This work received an honorable mention in the 103rd Newcomer Award of Kodansha's Magazine, and was published on Magapoke in December 2019. It was then uploaded to Chariot's twitter page, and has since received over 60,000 RTs and a great deal of attention.

biography.en:
Ai Yazawa attended a fashion school after high school but did not complete her studies there. Debuted with "Ano Natsu" in 1985 on Ribon Original.

In 2003, she got the Shogakukan Manga Award for Nana in girls' (shoujo) manga category.

Her pen name comes from Japanese singer Eikichi Yazawa, of whom she is a fan.

In 2009, Yazwa put Nana on indefinite hiatus after she contracted a serious disease. She got out of the hospital in 2010, but she admitted in a statement that she wasn’t sure if she’ll ever return to manga work for health reasons. Nana’s last update came in 2013, where Yazawa made a two-page special for the 100th issue celebration of the manga’s magazine, Shojo Beat.

(Source: Mangaupdates)
